Level 14 '''Scorpions''' are found on [[Ape Atoll]] and [[Crash Island]]. They will attack players if they are in human form, and they can also poison.

They are much smaller than standard scorpions, but are bigger than smaller scorpions such as [[pit scorpion]]s.
